management_steps.details: Severe deficiency - Children: 50 mg 8 hourly until resolution. Severe deficiency - Adults: 100 mg 8 hourly until skin lesions heal. Mild deficiency - Children: 50 mg daily for 1 week. Mild deficiency - Adults: 100 mg daily for 1 week.
Continue until resolution of major signs and symptoms / skin lesions heal.
